teachersSection.title: Experienced, caring, and qualified
teachersSection.subtitle: Each educator helps children grow with confidence, curiosity, and joy.

teachers.name: Mrs. Rajalakshmi
teachers.role: Sr. KG Class Teacher Cum Admin
experienceDetails: Has been working at Sanskriti Kindergarten for the past 6 years
Handles school enquiries and supports school functions and events
teachers.achievement: She has been working at our school for the past 6 years and is experienced in handling young children with care and patience. Her expertise includes phonics, public speaking, storytelling, rhymes, and activity-based learning. She follows an interactive teaching approach using games, songs, dance, and creative activities to make learning enjoyable for children.

teachers.name: Mrs. Latha Sundar
experienceDetails: 8 years of experience at Sanskriti Kindergarten Guindy
teachers.achievement: She has a friendly approach with children and is known for conducting special days that are both creative and educational. She is well known for her patience and kindness with children.

teachers.name: Ms. Musheera Fathima S.
teachers.achievement: Ms. Musheera Fathima S. is a dedicated teacher known for her interactive and student-friendly teaching style. She helps children improve their communication, reading, and writing skills through creative lessons and practical activities. She encourages confidence, critical thinking, and a love for literature among her students.

image.alt: Portrait of Ms. Musheera Fathima S.

teachers.name: Ms. Vasupradha
teachers.achievement: Ms. Vasupradha is an enthusiastic kindergarten teacher known for her warm and friendly teaching style. She uses storytelling, songs, games, and interactive activities to make learning fun and meaningful for children. She focuses on improving children's creativity, social skills, and early learning abilities in a positive classroom atmosphere.

teachers.name: Ms. Gomathi
teachers.achievement: Ms. Gomathi is a passionate and caring Montessori teacher who believes in creating a joyful and child-friendly learning environment. She encourages young learners to explore, discover, and learn through hands-on activities and creative play. Her teaching approach focuses on building confidence, communication skills, and independent learning habits in children.

teachers.name: Mrs. Ashwini
teachers.achievement: Mrs. Ashwini is a compassionate special educator who supports children with diverse learning needs through personalized teaching strategies and patient guidance. She believes every child can learn and grow with encouragement, understanding, and the right support.

teachers.name: Mrs. Sabila Banu M.
teachers.achievement: Mrs. M. Sabila Banu is a passionate and energetic preschool teacher with hands-on student teaching experience and a strong foundation in child development. She brings a creative approach to lesson planning, excellent communication skills, and patience to foster confidence and early learning in young children.

image.alt: Portrait of Mrs. Sabila Banu M.
